title: The pulse
summary: Under every song is a steady pulse you can tap your foot to.

steps.title: Beat
steps.body:
Tap your foot to a song and you are tapping its **beat**: the steady pulse under the music, evenly spaced like a clock ticking.

**Why it matters:** Everything in rhythm is measured in beats. A band stays together because everyone feels the same beat.

steps.title: Tap on any key
steps.body: In rhythm lessons any key works as a drum. Press it in time with the clicks.

items.prompt: Tap along with the clicks: 4 taps, one on each beat.
Keep going for longer: 8 taps, one on each beat.

steps.title: Find the beat
steps.body: Put on a song you like and tap any key along with it. Try not to speed up or slow down.

items.prompt: Tap a steady beat: 8 taps, one on each click.
